title_vi: older than … / more expensive than … (so sánh hơn với than)
theory_html:
A. comparative + than

A. so sánh hơn + than

  • ‘I’m taller than you.’ She’s taller than him.

    ‘Tôi cao hơn bạn.’ Cô ấy cao hơn anh ấy.

  • The Europa Hotel is more expensive than the Grand.

    Khách sạn Europa đắt hơn khách sạn Grand.

We use than after comparatives (older than … / more expensive than … etc.):

Dùng than sau so sánh hơn (older than … / more expensive than … v.v.):

  • Athens is older than Rome.

    Athens cổ hơn Rome.

  • Are oranges more expensive than bananas?

    Cam có đắt hơn chuối không?

  • It’s easier to take a taxi than to take the bus.

    Đi taxi dễ hơn đi xe buýt.

  • ‘How are you today?’ ‘Not bad. Better than yesterday.’

    ‘Hôm nay bạn thế nào?’ ‘Không tệ. Khá hơn hôm qua.’

  • The restaurant is more crowded than usual.

    Nhà hàng đông hơn mọi khi.

B. than me / than him … or than I am / than he can …

B. than me / than him … hoặc than I am / than he can …

We usually say: than me / than him / than her / than us / than them. You can say:

Ta thường nói: than me / than him / than her / than us / than them. Có thể nói:

  • I can run faster than him. or I can run faster than he can.

    Tôi chạy nhanh hơn anh ấy.

  • You are a better singer than me. or You are a better singer than I am.

    Bạn hát hay hơn tôi.

  • I got up earlier than her. or I got up earlier than she did.

    Tôi dậy sớm hơn cô ấy.

C. more / less than …

  • A: How much did your shoes cost? £60? B: No, more than that. (= more than £60)

    A: Giày của bạn giá bao nhiêu? 60 bảng à? B: Không, hơn thế.

  • The film was very short – less than an hour.

    Bộ phim rất ngắn – chưa đến một tiếng.

  • They have more money than they need.

    Họ có nhiều tiền hơn mức họ cần.

  • You go out more than me.

    Bạn ra ngoài nhiều hơn tôi.

D. a bit older / much older etc.

D. a bit older / much older v.v.

a bit / much + bigger / older / better / more difficult / more expensive + than …

a bit (hơn một chút) / much (hơn nhiều) + bigger / older / better / more difficult / more expensive + than …

  • Box A is a bit bigger than Box B. / Box C is much bigger than Box D.

    Hộp A lớn hơn một chút so với hộp B. / Hộp C lớn hơn nhiều so với hộp D.

  • Canada is much bigger than France.

    Canada lớn hơn nhiều so với Pháp.

  • Sue is a bit older than Joe – she’s 25 and he’s 24.

    Sue lớn tuổi hơn một chút so với Joe – cô ấy 25 còn anh ấy 24.

  • The hotel was much more expensive than I expected.

    Khách sạn đắt hơn nhiều so với tôi nghĩ.

  • You go out much more than me.

    Bạn ra ngoài nhiều hơn hẳn tôi.

mcq.question: Today it is 12 degrees. Yesterday it was 10 degrees. → It’s ___ today than yesterday.
mcq.full: Today it is 12 degrees. Yesterday it was 10 degrees. → It’s a bit warmer today than yesterday.
mcq.vi: Hôm nay 12 độ. Hôm qua 10 độ. → Hôm nay ấm hơn một chút.
mcq.expl:
a bit (= a little) / much + comparative.
a bit (hơn một chút) / much (hơn nhiều) + so sánh hơn.
Điểm ngữ pháp: a bit warmer.
mcq.key: Today it is 12 degrees. Yesterday it was 10 degrees. → It’s ___ today than yesterday.|a bit warmer

mcq.question: Sarah is an excellent tennis player. I’m not very good. → Sarah is a ___ tennis player than me.
mcq.full: Sarah is an excellent tennis player. I’m not very good. → Sarah is a much better tennis player than me.
mcq.vi: Sarah chơi quần vợt xuất sắc. Tôi không giỏi lắm. → Sarah chơi giỏi hơn nhiều so với tôi.
mcq.expl:
a bit (= a little) / much + comparative.
a bit (hơn một chút) / much (hơn nhiều) + so sánh hơn.
Điểm ngữ pháp: much better.
mcq.key: Sarah is an excellent tennis player. I’m not very good. → Sarah is a ___ tennis player than me.|much better
